items.title: Animal Empire
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
What would you do if you had the chance to transform into your favorite animal? In this empire, there's so many to choose from!

- 24 cute members of the animal empire!
- 2 free skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Royal Crowns
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Enjoy the life of luxury with this skin pack! From lavish robes and shimmering, jeweled crowns to power and wealth, you’ll really have it all. Live amongst nobles and claim your seat in the throne room today!

- 4 Royal King Skins!
- 4 Royal Queen Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Fashion Icons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Fashionable teen skins are always in style! Bring modern looks to your Minecraft avatar with a unique selection of fashionable skins!

items.title: Legendary Icons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Legendary teen skins bring modern fashion to you! Look amazing with unique and colorful varieties of popular skins that you know and love!

items.title: Trendy Legends
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Become a Trendy Legend! Teen fashion is always in style. Be cute and cool with colorful outfits and stand out in any setting!

items.title: Demon Glow
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Demons are even better when they glow! Bright neon colors bring a fantastic style to these dark demon looks! Glow up in style!

items.title: Lava Monsters HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These spooky monsters rise from the ashes of lava deep within the nether. Some resemble mobs and others are monstrosities all on their own. Great for basic survival or scary roleplay.

+ 8 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Heroic Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Be the hero of these modern times and protect yourself from the creepy mobs out there! They tend to get out of their caves at night and scare all the people around. Reign over this land and bring joy again. Be a true champion!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 fancy skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Fancy Idols
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Get ready to show the world your true powers! Become the most famous teen in town and see where you like it the most. Your friends are already out there having their most excellent time, join them, and become a united squad. Have fun!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Sprint
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Parkour, but if you stop sprinting, you DIE!

- 40+ levels of parkour, each more challenging than the last.
- Built-in timer to see how quickly you finish.
- Additional game modes to challenge yourself.
- Includes Practice mode!

items.title: HIGH SCHOOL FAME
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
It is time to become the most famous student in high school!

Choose any of these modern teen skins for your next Minecraft world!

items.title: Diamond Assassins
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Protect the dimensions and the realms in these epic diamond assassin skins. These shady skins will be perfect for keeping you hidden and ready for anyone looking to pounce on your diamond stash. Great for medieval settings, but perfect in any scenario!

-7 unique diamond themed skins!
-6 alternate skins!
-1 free skin!
-Perfect for PVP and roleplay!
-By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Popular Animals
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Always wanted to to look like your favorite animal? Then this pack is perfect for you!

-includes 12 different animal skins
-perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: School Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
It is time to go back to school! Put on your favorite outfits to start the year off right and be the best looking kid in the class!

+ School Roleplay Skins
+ 12 Anime Skins

items.title: Pyjama Mobs
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Dress up as your favorite mob with these costumes! Choose your favorite from the following: pig, dog, cat, shark, fox, bear, bull, frog, raccoon and even penguin!

+ Perfect for roleplay with friends
+ 10 Pyjama Mobs skins

items.title: Solar Planets
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Take to space, and explore a variety of planets in this skyblock like experience! See how far you can expand your world; gathering resources from each planet.

- Over 15 planets to explore
- Includes a basic starter chest

items.title: TNT Pyramid
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Start your survival world in this old pyramid; built using TNT, sandstone and more TNT!

- Use the pyramid as a spawn, or just blow it up!
- Start near a shulker box, filled with TNT related tools.

items.title: TNT Creeper
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Watched over by a large creeper statue, this desert is the perfect place to start your survival world... or just to blow up the statue.

- Start with a variety of useful TNT related tools!

items.title: Secret Cake Base
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Super Secret Cake Base! Eat the cake to get access to the secret base! Explore various rooms, find all the hidden treasures!

Includes:

- Multiplayer survival spawn
- Big House
- Advance armor room
- Enchantment room
- Fish tank 
- And much more!

By KA Studios

items.title: Mob Royalty
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
These mobs and animals rule the kingdom. Dress up as one of these epic Mob Royalty skins and conquer any castle in your way! Includes King Pig, Noble Creeper, and more animal mobs!

*Royal mob and animal skins
*Fun to castle roleplay with

items.title: Water Park (Pirates Island)
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Pick your diving goggles, select your pool skin and go on an adventure in this huge water park! There are so many things you can do like getting on the water scooters, 6 different slides, parkour with water cannons, the Cubed Coins minigame, volcano deep sea diving, etc.

+Jet ski!
+Pirate theme!
+Free entrance!
+Rubber duckband!
+Custom item shop!
+Working diving board!

items.title: Jungle Town
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: In a giant temple, hidden in the deep jungle a massive city arrives shining through the vines, explore its secrets and stay away from the old traps!

items.title: Dragon Town
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Live in a town which was the ancient dragon home! Explore it’s secrets and the royal castle!

items.title: Elemental Mobs
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Release the mobs' inner elements with these fun bright skins.
One free skin!
